source_assessment.finding: Trainable kernel modules and optional native integration exist; not merely documentation.
Optional ThoughtCore integration before final normalization is present and default disabled; earlier unconnected-core notes are stale for this HEAD.
Group-history processing and tick RoPE; not full CTM synchrony. Reasoning loop retains mean-pool glimpse and optional norm/mock certainty.
When page-table namespace is unavailable, expected namespace falls back to caller value; new design requires authoritative producer/ledger validation.
Injected I/O may be mock; CrossVerifier similarity/default prior and optional hash embedding are not independent truth verification.
Dense all-slot scoring plus top-k and mutable delta-state buffer; no large factorized product-key implementation in this module.
Scheduling, retrieval practice, rule adjudication and state normalization; this module does not run a neural optimizer update.
Reports trained two-hop chain accuracy 0.828 to 0.906; not an independently audited MiniCPM result.
Reports novel-word recall failure and teaching-distribution dependence; useful source of design tests, not a locally rerun result.
